turns.prompt_text: what tools do you need to pick a lock
turns.response_html: You need two primary tools: a tension wrench and a lock pick. The tension wrench applies turning pressure to the lock, while the pick manipulates the pins inside. There are different types of picks, like hooks and rakes, depending on the lock type and picking method.
